text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, I petitioned the student council to 
build a sauna hut on campus, but they told 
me it would be difficult!

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
Saunas are indeed magnificent. A dialogue 
with oneself! Challenging one's limits! 
Mental focus sharpening as the heat 
rises...!

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! I knew I couldn't give up! —Time to 
go talk to Trainer Kashimoto!
